title: Evidence-Derived Mechanism Analysis
purpose: Derive auditable mechanism context from admitted provider series and official evidence without asking descriptive claims to contain interpretive semantic labels.
rules: Mechanism analysis consumes only snapshots whose source claims reached CWA admission.
Computed metrics are derived observations, not new source facts and not CWA evidence.
G2 Constraint cannot be promoted from market-series metrics alone; a regulator/official behavioral constraint must be present.
G14 Reconfiguration requires before/after structural composition evidence for the same subsystem.

G16 Continuity may create a subsystem-level human-review candidate when organized issuer reporting/function is observed across multiple reporting periods, but it cannot automatically promote DOSSIER-US system continuity.
No mechanism candidate creates an RP position.
All thresholds are admission guards, not scores of political/economic quality.
